notes.R: R = [GroundModule+0x28], the fighter's ground-collision record (0x6E0 = 1760 bytes), one entry of the 350-entry pool at allocation site 0x7102606480 (the 616,000-byte block). It is NOT stage geometry.
notes.L(k): L(k) = [R+0x10+0x30*k], the stage collision LINE object the shape currently touches in direction k (null = no contact). k: 0 = up/ceiling (by elimination), 1 = left wall, 2 = right wall, 3 = down/floor. Touch mask bit k <-> slot k, so mask 1=up, 2=left, 4=right, 8=down; slots 4..7 (+0xD0,+0x100,+0x130,+0x160) are tested for mask bits 4..7. Line objects are a separate allocation (size not identified).
notes.CS(i): CS(i) = [CameraModule+0x28] + i*0x150, camera subject record i (count at CameraModule+0x20).
notes.getter_args: argument types from the Itanium export name, after the BattleObjectModuleAccessor*: j = unsigned int, i = int, GroundTouchID = enum (int index 0..7).
notes.getter_read_only: true when the exported path (lua_bind wrapper + slot function + callees) makes no guest store except to its own stack frame; false if it writes object state, a global scratch buffer, or a refcount.
notes.getter_null_safe: true when every pointer the getter loads along the path after the module pointer is null-checked before being dereferenced; the module pointer at boma+0x58/0x60 and R itself are never checked, so any getter dereferencing R is false.
notes.address_getters: getters that return an address (correct_pos, get_shape_safe_pos, hang_cliff_pos, get_main_camera_target_pos) are recorded as formula 'computed: returns the address ...' and confidence probable.
notes.camera_trace_lines: p2_targets.json lists CameraModule lines 0x80..0x100, beyond the 0x58-byte object (fighter factory allocates 0x58 bytes in f_71006882d0); those lines are outside the object and are not mapped here.

The pool is the 616,000-byte block of allocation site 0x7102606480 (350*0x6E0 = 0x96640, zeroed by a 0x96640-byte memset right after the allocation, each entry then constructed by f_71005344a0).

fields.type: pointer to touched stage line (null = no contact); k=0 up/ceiling, 1 left wall, 2 right wall, 3 down/floor
fields.formula: computed: returns 1 if for any set bit k of mask the slot-k pointer is non-null
fields.evidence: slot fn f_71004635b0 tests mask bits 0..7 against [R+0x10+0x30k] != 0. Direction names: is_ignore_fighter_other_wall_l reads slot 1, _wall_r slot 2, is_passable_ground and get_down_correct_edge_pos slot 3; slot 0 by elimination. ground_touch_flag f_7100462690 builds 1|2|4|8 from slots 0..3 directly (read-only); get_touch_flag f_7100462780 ORs is_touch(1),(8),(4),(2). Cleared (memset R+0x10, 0x300 bytes) by fighter slot 0x98 f_71006c9e90 and by set_correct when leaving correct kind 0.

fields.type: touch slot record; only the first word (line pointer) is identified
fields.formula: computed: returns [R+0x10+0x30*index] if non-null, its weak-ref block [line+0x118] has count != 1 and line byte +0x100 != 0, else null
fields.evidence: f_7100463c40 multiplies the index by 0x30, loads +0x10, atomically increments and then releases a refcount at [line+0x118]+0x10 (so not read-only).

fields.type: vec4 float: floor line normal
fields.formula: plain load through fixed pointer path when mask == 8 and the floor line is non-null (zero vector otherwise); other masks: computed (sum of the touched lines' +0xA0 normals, normalised)
fields.evidence: get_touch_normal slot f_7100462030 tail-calls f_71005371b0(R, mask): for mask 8 it loads [R+0xA0] and returns its +0xA0 vector; other bits add [R+0x10/+0x40/+0x70...]+0xA0 and normalise. get_touch_normal_x/_y return lanes 0/1. Two pointer levels: R then line.

fields.path: [L(k)]+0xC4 (u32 flags), +0xC6 bit4 (= bit 20), +0xD0 (u32 material), +0x100 (u8 valid), +0xF8 (u32 id)
fields.type: stage line attributes: flags word (bit 7 ignore-fighter-other on walls, bit 13 passable floor, bit 20 disables both), material type u32 at +0xD0
fields.formula: computed: picks a slot (bit0 -> 0, else bit3 -> 3, else bit1 -> 1, else bit2 -> 2) and returns [L+0xD0] if L non-null, [L+0x100] != 0 and bit 4 of byte L+0xC6 clear, else 0; mask == 8 exactly returns GM+0xBC instead
fields.evidence: f_71004628c0; is_passable_ground f_7100463fe0 returns bit 13 of [L(3)+0xC4]; is_ignore_fighter_other_wall_l/r return bit 7 of [L(1)/L(2)+0xC4].

fields.type: u8 bits: bit0 = left-wall touch began this frame, bit1 = right-wall touch began this frame
fields.formula: computed: is_touch_moment (slot 0x4A8, f_7100463660) uses these bits for masks 2 and 4 and the slot pointers for masks 1, 8 and higher; the exported getter ORs results for masks 1, 8, 4, 2
fields.evidence: f_7100462820 calls slot 0x4A8 four times; f_7100463660 reads byte R+0x6D1 bits 0/1.

fields.type: u32 collision flags: bit0 passable-check, bit1, bit10 from init param, bit17 cleared each frame, bit18 (0x40000) cliff grabbed, bit20 floor vanishing, bit27 ignore fighter other, bit29 attached

fields.type: rhombus mode: four 16-byte vec4 points relative to R+0x4C0, in order up (top), down (bottom), left, right: the fighter's ECB. Circle mode: +0x3C0 = centre offset vec4, +0x3D0 = radius float
fields.formula: computed: if correct kind GM+0x44 != 0, returns the world point R+0x4C0 + R+0x3D0 (slot 0xB8 with arg 1); else Posture position + the local point R+0x3D0 (slot 0xB8 with arg 0). get_up_pos / get_left_pos / get_right_pos do the same with +0x3C0 / +0x3E0 / +0x3F0
fields.evidence: slot 0xB8 f_710045eee0: arg 0 returns the address R+0x3C0 (rhombus); arg 1 writes position+points into the global static 4-point buffer at 0x71052B87C0, so the getter is not read-only (global scratch, not fighter state). get_down_pos f_7100464460 reads buffer+0x10, get_up_pos +0x0, get_left_pos +0x20, get_right_pos +0x30; get_touch_pos(mask) maps 1 -> up, 8 -> down, 2 -> left, 4 -> right. get_width = |x(+0x3F0) - x(+0x3E0)| (rhombus) or 2*radius (circle).
